id: title:danielcarletti:resume mongodb first syncs and cap incremental reads

review.posthog_relevance: Supports warehouse ingestion and incremental read correctness, specifically enabling descending index compatibility checks and implementing an upper-bound cap to prevent re-reading documents.
review.reason: The chunk P1.F1 demonstrates a cohesive implementation of warehouse ingestion improvements. P1.F1.H1 adds the `DESCENDING` import, which is necessary for the index compatibility check to distinguish ascending from descending directions, a prerequisite for range-and-sort index detection. P1.F1.H2 and P1.F1.H3 implement the upper-bound parameter and its application, allowing the read

observations.behavior: Adds DESCENDING to pymongo imports; no other pymongo changes.
observations.code_quote: from pymongo import ASCENDING, DESCENDING, MongoClient
observations.posthog_connection: Allows descending direction checks in index compatibility; without DESCENDING, the new index compatibility check cannot distinguish ascending from descending, potentially breaking the range-and-sort index detection.

observations.behavior: Adds upper_bound parameter to _build_query; no other query changes.
observations.posthog_connection: Allows the query builder to accept an upper bound, which is later used to cap incremental reads; without this, the upper bound cannot be passed to the query construction.

observations.behavior: Adds conditional upper bound application to query; no other query changes.
observations.posthog_connection: Implements the upper bound cap on the incremental field; without this, the read would not be capped, potentially re-reading documents already passed.
